text.brief: On December 5, 1978, the zoo electrician Wei Jingsheng posted The Fifth Modernization on the Xidan wall in Beijing.
text.record: The poster argued that the Party's Four Modernizations would fail without democracy. Deng Xiaoping tolerated the wall while its posters attacked his rivals and told foreign visitors that the constitution allowed them. In March 1979 Wei warned that Deng was becoming a new dictator, and police arrested him on March 29 ([The Chinese democracy movement of 1978-1981: Beijing, March 1979 (Beijing Spring site, University of Vienna)](https://beijing-spring.univie.ac.at/en/photos/big-character-posters/beijing-march-1979/)). A court sentenced him to fifteen years in October ([Human Rights Watch: Wei Jingsheng released (1997; NGO)](https://www.hrw.org/news/1997/11/16/wei-jingsheng-released); [Independent Chinese PEN Center: Case No. 33 (1979), Wei Jingsheng (NGO)](https://www.chinesepen.org/english/no-13-yu-zhang-33)). In December the city moved the wall to a park and required every writer to register a name and workplace ([The Democracy Wall (Beijing Spring site, University of Vienna)](https://beijing-spring.univie.ac.at/en/the-democracy-movement-1978-1981/the-democracy-wall); [Opletal, The 1978-1981 Democracy Wall Movement (Journal of the European Association for Chinese Studies, 2021)](https://journals.univie.ac.at/index.php/jeacs/article/download/6561/6579/15915)). In 1980 the National People's Congress struck the right to write big-character posters from the constitution ([Resolution of the Third Session of the Fifth National People's Congress on amending Article 45 of the Constitution, September 1980 (PRC government site)](https://jjjcz.mee.gov.cn/djfg/gjflfg/xf/198009/t19800901_444124.html); [Constitution of the PRC (1978), Article 45 (CPC member site)](https://news.12371.cn/2015/03/18/ARTI1426667115741768.shtml?from=singlemessage)).
text.reading: The Party let speech run while it served a struggle among leaders and closed the channel once the speech turned on the new leader, which is Stratagem 16. Wei's arrest came seven weeks after Deng left the United States, once normalization and the state visit had closed.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. Washington read tolerance as reform and set no test for when the tolerance would end.
text.fix: Judge openness by what the state does to its critics after the visit ends, and say so in public.
